---
title: Vue Components
description: Dynamic and interactive UI components.
---

For complex client-side interactions, Rimelight UI provides Vue components that hydrate seamlessly on top of standard Astro layouts.

## Key Components

- **RLACommandPalette**: Accessible, keyboard-navigable command center.
- **RLAChatPrompt**: Standard AI prompting block component.
- **RLAColorPicker**: Color selection field with preview.
